title: Briefing for 2026-09-19
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-19: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike. Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged. 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices. Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household. UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar. Why de-dollarization discussions are more talk, less action.
global: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron. Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House. Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?. At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque. 'We simply don't know' - JP Morgan struggling to forecast oil prices due to Trump's war with Iran. Flight chaos caused by 'millisecond' software defect, report says.
philippines: Villars face graft complaints over PrimeWater contracts | The wRap. How watchdogs got sidelined again in 2027 House budget talks. For Aznar Shipping, going public means growth – and dodging third-gen curse. FACT CHECK: No evidence Romualdez has stage 4 cancer.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
